Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed POC success criteria

Hi Emily + Rahul,

Thanks again for the great kickoff earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we scope the POC: 

Summary / Goals:
- Validate latency and cost targets for real-time triage: 95th percentile latency < 400ms for 512-token requests, and cost per 1k requests under target baseline (TBD).
- Measure classification accuracy against your priority intents (triage/categorization) and reduction in manual work for nurses.
- Verify secure data flows and logging that meet Coral Health’s compliance checklist.

Proposed success criteria (attached: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf):
- Latency: p95 < 400ms (95% of inference under target)
- Quality: intent accuracy >= 88% on the evaluation set
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate over a 72-hour soak

Next steps / timeline suggestions:
1) Agree success criteria + dataset access (this week)
2) Redwood SE kickoff and environment provisioning (next week)
3) 4-week evaluation window with weekly syncs
4) Final readout and exec decision (target: first week of October)

Marcus (cc) will own the SE side and kick off the technical runbook. If the success criteria look reasonable to you, can we lock a POC kickoff for the week of Sept 27?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
